The '''call box''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that can only be used by someone who can [[channel]].

==Appearance==
It is a small stone cube, with intricate designs on each face. 

==Use==
It was given to [[Sevanna]] by [[Sammael]] so she can call him after she captures Rand.{{ref/book|6|Prologue}} After she does, though, she decides not to use it.{{ref/book|6|53}} After the defeat at [[Dumai's Wells]], she still has it{{ref/book|7|Prologue}} and eventually has [[Someryn]] use it to call Sammael (whom Sevanna knows as Caddar).{{ref/book|7|20}} When Someryn channels into it, it draws both ''[[saidin]]'' and ''[[saidar]]''.
